purpose: Predeclare the bounded search for one plain-success Hugging Face model/task pair before any autonomous PRA treatment.
claim_boundary: This is an engine-admission search, not a population-accuracy estimate. Every attempted plain task is retained. The sequence stops at the first official plain success, and no PRA arm is permitted before that success.

ordered_tasks.rationale: Short, source-localized baseline success with a minimal deterministic code correction; selected before execution.
Independent minimal baseline success; attempted only if the first declared task fails plain admission.
Third and final declared admission task; attempted only if both earlier tasks fail.

stopping_rule.success: Stop at the first official plain resolution and freeze that exact model/task/configuration for PRA-100 followed by PRA-90.
stopping_rule.failure: If all three plain tasks fail, record a model/agent admission failure. Do not run PRA and do not continue resampling tasks.
stopping_rule.invalid_run: Retry only infrastructure-contaminated runs in a new immutable directory; preserve and label the original output.
